name: Virgin Islands Ecotours
overview: Kayak and snorkel experiences around the Virgin Islands, including St. Thomas’s Mangrove Lagoon. Compare the selected excursion, starting point and time on the water before choosing your day.

publicListings.title: St Thomas Mangrove Lagoon Kayak and Snorkel Tour in the US Virgin Islands

planningNotes.title: Choose the right island
planningNotes.text: The operator offers activities on more than one Virgin Island. Check the departure island and meeting point on your selected tour, rather than relying on the operator name alone.

planningNotes.title: Check the activity mix
planningNotes.text: The listed Mangrove Lagoon experience is a kayak and snorkel tour. Confirm whether a hike, equipment, transport or lunch is included in the particular option you select.

planningNotes.title: Allow for the whole journey
planningNotes.text: The approximate tour duration does not establish your time from ship to meeting point and back. Check transfers, check-in and your own return deadline separately.

name: Cruz Bay Watersports
overview: Sailing, snorkeling and sunset experiences with departures on St. John and St. Thomas. Start with your island and departure location, then choose the outing that fits your time ashore.

publicListings.title: St. John Days End Sunset Sail with Open Bar from the Westin
St. John PiZZA Pi Snorkel Sail with Beach Stop, Lunch & Open Bar - Westin

planningNotes.title: Select your departure
planningNotes.text: Tours depart from different islands and resort locations. The Westin departures below should not be treated as downtown Cruz Bay or St. Thomas departures.

planningNotes.title: Lunch and sunset are different plans
planningNotes.text: The selected Pizza Pi excursion is a longer daytime outing; the sunset sail is shorter but later. Compare both the start time and return journey before choosing.

planningNotes.title: Check cross-island details
planningNotes.text: For a BVI excursion or an inter-island transfer, ask about required travel documents, separate transport and the planned return. Those details are not established by the listings below.

name: Bahamas Jet Boat
overview: Nassau-based boat excursions and island experiences. Use the official operator’s current tour descriptions to distinguish swimming-pig outings, beach activities and what is included in each departure.

publicListings.title: Nassau Swimming Pigs: Snorkeling, Lunch & Private Beach Club

planningNotes.title: Identify the exact outing
planningNotes.text: A swimming-pig excursion, a jet-boat ride and a beach-club package can be different products. Match the actual itinerary before comparing prices.

planningNotes.title: Check transport and meeting points
planningNotes.text: Confirm where to meet, whether port or hotel transfers are included, and the check-in deadline for the selected trip.

planningNotes.title: Plan the return
planningNotes.text: For a cruise port day, compare the operator’s stated return time and transfer arrangements with your ship’s confirmed all-aboard time. A generic tour duration is not enough.

name: Jolly Pirates
overview: Pirate-ship snorkeling and sunset sailing in Aruba. Compare the time on the water, swimming stops and the distinction between a sightseeing sail and a dinner experience.

publicListings.title: Jolly Pirate Sunset Sail with Open Bar
Jolly Pirate Afternoon Sail with Snorkeling
Adults Only Jolly Pirate Sunset Grub and Grog Dinner Sail

planningNotes.title: Choose sail or snorkel
planningNotes.text: A sunset sail and an afternoon snorkeling excursion do not have the same activity mix. Use the selected product’s inclusions rather than assuming every cruise includes swimming.

planningNotes.title: Check the age rules
planningNotes.text: The selected Grub and Grog dinner sail is listed as adults only. Confirm the permitted ages on the exact departure if traveling with children.

planningNotes.title: Compare meals and transport
planningNotes.text: Check whether food, drinks and transfers are included for your option. Compare the same departure, passenger categories and mandatory charges across channels.

name: Kayaking Puerto Rico
overview: Guided kayaking and aquatic excursions in Puerto Rico, including bioluminescent-bay outings in Fajardo. The place, evening schedule and journey to and from the launch matter as much as the activity itself.

publicListings.title: Bio Bay Kayak Tour in Fajardo

planningNotes.title: Fajardo is a specific location
planningNotes.text: The listed bio-bay departure is in Fajardo. Do not treat a Vieques or San Juan experience with a similar title as the same product.

planningNotes.title: Include the evening transfer
planningNotes.text: Confirm check-in, the actual launch time and transport back to your accommodation or ship. A two-hour activity does not describe the complete journey.

planningNotes.title: Ask about participation
planningNotes.text: Check swimming expectations, paddling requirements, age limits and any assistance needed with the operator. Missing accessibility information should be confirmed before booking.

name: Sea Spray Cruises
overview: Catamaran sailing, sunset cruises and land-and-sea excursions in St. Lucia. Compare a full-day itinerary with a shorter evening sail, and establish whether the departure works for your hotel or cruise port.

publicListings.title: St Lucia Full-Day Catamaran Sightseeing Cruise With Snorkeling
Champagne Sunset Sail in St. Lucia

planningNotes.title: Full day or sunset
planningNotes.text: The selected full-day excursion is listed at about eight hours; the sunset sail at about two. Transport and check-in may add time beyond those durations.

planningNotes.title: Establish your pickup
planningNotes.text: Rodney Bay Marina, hotel pickup and cruise-port pickup are not interchangeable. Confirm the actual pickup and drop-off arrangements for the selected booking option.

planningNotes.title: Check your ship window
planningNotes.text: An eight-hour hotel excursion is not automatically a suitable shore excursion. Establish port transfers, check-in, return time and your ship’s confirmed deadline first.

name: Marlin del Rey
city: Tamarindo / Playas del Coco, Costa Rica
overview: Catamaran sailing from Tamarindo and Playas del Coco on Costa Rica’s Pacific coast. Confirm the departure beach and selected sailing option before comparing transport, timings and total cost.
areasServed: Tamarindo / Playas del Coco, Costa Rica

publicListings.title: Marlin del Rey Catamaran – Tamarindo & Playas del Coco
publicListings.supplierName: Marlin del Rey Catamaran Sailing Tours

planningNotes.title: Choose the correct departure
planningNotes.text: Tamarindo and Playas del Coco are separate starting locations. Select the right option for where you are staying, rather than assuming the departure is the same.

planningNotes.title: Count transport and check-in
planningNotes.text: The selected listing describes approximately four and a half hours. Add the journey to the departure point and the operator’s check-in requirement to your own plan.

planningNotes.title: Keep the seller distinct
planningNotes.text: Other resellers can advertise an experience aboard Marlin del Rey. Match the underlying departure, inclusions, transport and cancellation terms before treating two offers as equivalent.

name: Runners Adventures
overview: Adventure excursions in the Dominican Republic, including Punta Cana’s Monkeyland and zipline combination. Check the full activity sequence, pickup area and participation rules for the exact product you choose.

publicListings.title: Punta Cana Monkeyland and Zipline Two Adventures in One Day

planningNotes.title: A combination takes a full day
planningNotes.text: The selected Monkeyland and zipline combination is listed at about eight hours. A shorter single-activity tour is not an equivalent comparison.

planningNotes.title: Confirm your pickup area
planningNotes.text: Hotel location can affect pickup and return timing. Establish the route for your accommodation instead of relying on a general Punta Cana label.

planningNotes.title: Review each activity
planningNotes.text: Check participation and equipment requirements for the zipline and animal-visit portions separately. A combined experience needs to work for every mandatory segment.

name: Cabo Blue
overview: Trimaran snorkeling and sunset outings in Cabo San Lucas. Compare a daytime Santa Maria Bay excursion with a shorter evening cruise, then check the marina meeting point and what each option includes.

publicListings.title: Cabo San Lucas and Santa Maria Bay Snorkeling Sightseeing Cruise
Cabo San Lucas Sunset Cruise with Open Bar and Snacks

planningNotes.title: Match the experience
planningNotes.text: The selected snorkel outing and sunset cruise have different durations and activities. A sunset product should not be assumed to include a snorkeling stop.

planningNotes.title: Find the check-in point
planningNotes.text: Confirm the exact marina meeting location, check-in cutoff and how you will get there. Hotel or cruise-port pickup is not assumed on this page.

planningNotes.title: Compare the complete total
planningNotes.text: Check food, drinks, equipment, passenger categories and any mandatory charges for the same departure. No dated savings comparison has been established here.

name: Body Glove Hawaii
overview: Kailua-Kona snorkeling, dinner cruises and seasonal ocean experiences. Compare the daytime snorkel outing with the historical dinner cruise to Kealakekua Bay, including the departure time and return journey.

publicListings.title: Big Island Historical Dinner Cruise to Kealakekua Bay
Deluxe Snorkel & Dolphin Watch Aboard a Luxury Catamaran from Kailua-Kona

planningNotes.title: Choose daytime or dinner
planningNotes.text: The selected snorkel excursion is listed at about four and a half hours, and the dinner cruise at about three. They are different experiences, not interchangeable price comparisons.

planningNotes.title: Check Kona access
planningNotes.text: Confirm the exact boarding location and transfer arrangements. If arriving by cruise ship, establish tender and return timing separately from the boat-tour duration.

planningNotes.title: Confirm the participation details
planningNotes.text: Ask about water entry, swimming ability, assistance and equipment for the selected snorkeling product. A dinner cruise does not establish the same physical requirements.
